newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open up on Dow rally, gains seen limited.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open up on Dow rally, gains seen limited.

text.p: UK shares, bolstered by Wall Street's 60-point advance on Monday, pushed higher at the start of trade on Tuesday but the market's near-term upside is seen limited as investors continue to fret about possible interest rate hikes.
The FTSE 100 index, which had dropped 61 points the previous two sessions, was 23.8 points firmer to 4,275.5 by 0734 GMT.

"The opening spike was inevitable after the Dow's rally," the head of trading at a large brokerage said. "But unless we see some volume behind the move, it won't last -- and I'm not looking for any brave buying just yet."
